# temporalcloud_caller_rate_limit (Resource)

Provisions a caller rate limit, which limits the rate at which other namespaces can call a namespace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    temporalcloud = {
      source = "temporalio/temporalcloud"
    }
  }
}

provider "temporalcloud" {

}

# The target namespace, which the caller rate limits protect.
resource "temporalcloud_namespace" "mynamespace" {
  name           = "terraform-target-namespace"
  regions        = ["aws-us-east-1"]
  api_key_auth   = true
  retention_days = 14
}

resource "temporalcloud_namespace" "caller_50" {
  name           = "terraform-caller-50"
  regions        = ["aws-us-east-1"]
  api_key_auth   = true
  retention_days = 14
}

resource "temporalcloud_namespace" "caller_0" {
  name           = "terraform-caller-0"
  regions        = ["aws-us-east-1"]
  api_key_auth   = true
  retention_days = 14
}

# Default rule: unmatched calling namespaces get 100 requests per second.
resource "temporalcloud_caller_rate_limit" "default" {
  namespace_id = temporalcloud_namespace.mynamespace.id

  namespace_default = {
    rps = 100
  }
}

# Exact rule: this calling namespace gets 50 requests per second.
resource "temporalcloud_caller_rate_limit" "caller_50" {
  namespace_id = temporalcloud_namespace.mynamespace.id

  namespace_limit = {
    namespace_id = temporalcloud_namespace.caller_50.id
    rps          = 50
  }
}

# Exact rule: this calling namespace gets blocked.
resource "temporalcloud_caller_rate_limit" "caller_0" {
  namespace_id = temporalcloud_namespace.mynamespace.id

  namespace_limit = {
    namespace_id = temporalcloud_namespace.caller_0.id
    rps          = 0
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace_id` (String) The target namespace being protected by this limit, formatted as `<namespace>.<account_id>`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `namespace_default` (Attributes) The default limit for calling namespaces that don't match a `namespace_limit` rule. The target namespace can have at most one. Exactly one of `namespace_default` or `namespace_limit` must be set, and switching between them replaces the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--namespace_default))
- `namespace_limit` (Attributes) A limit for one specific calling namespace. The target namespace can have at most one per calling namespace. Exactly one of `namespace_default` or `namespace_limit` must be set, and switching between them replaces the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--namespace_limit))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the caller rate limit, formatted as `<namespace_id>/<caller_rate_limit_id>`.

<a id="nestedatt--namespace_default"></a>
### Nested Schema for `namespace_default`

Required:

- `rps` (Number) The maximum requests per second allowed from the callers this rule applies to. A value of 0 blocks all traffic from them.


<a id="nestedatt--namespace_limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `namespace_limit`

Required:

- `namespace_id` (String) The calling namespace this limit applies to, formatted as `<namespace>.<account_id>`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `rps` (Number) The maximum requests per second allowed from the callers this rule applies to. A value of 0 blocks all traffic from them.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Caller Rate Limits can be imported to incorporate existing Caller Rate Limits into your Terraform pipeline.
# To import a Caller Rate Limit, you need
# - a resource configuration in your Terraform configuration file/module to accept the imported Caller Rate Limit. In the example below, the placeholder is "temporalcloud_caller_rate_limit" "crlimport"
# - the ID of the target namespace, which includes the Namespace Name and Account ID available at the top of the Namespace's page in the Temporal Cloud UI. In the example below, this is namespaceid.acctid
# - the Caller Rate Limit's ID, which is found using the Temporal Cloud CLI command temporal cloud namespace caller-rate-limit list --namespace namespaceid.acctid. Add --caller-namespace-default or --caller-namespace callernamespaceid.acctid to find a specific rule. In the example below, this is 405f7da4224a43d99c211904ed9b3819

terraform import temporalcloud_caller_rate_limit.crlimport namespaceid.acctid/405f7da4224a43d99c211904ed9b3819
```
